title: Malta's Best Restaurants - A Local's Guide
author: Tiago Ferreira
excerpt: Discover the best dining experiences in Malta, from hidden gems to award-winning restaurants.
content:
Introduction

Malta's food scene is vibrant and diverse, blending Mediterranean flavors with international influences. After 15+ years of travel, here are my top restaurant picks.

Fine Dining

Noni: Located in Valletta, this Michelin-starred restaurant offers exceptional Mediterranean cuisine with a creative twist.

De Mondion: Overlooking the Three Cities, this restaurant provides fine dining with stunning views.

Local Favorites

Tal-Petut: Authentic Maltese cuisine in a cozy setting. Try the rabbit stew (coniglio)!

Plumerella: Traditional Maltese fish dishes with fresh daily catches.
